{{Top|leg}}
'''Subtugs''' were underwater craft that acted as [[Cargo tug/Legends|cargo tugs]] for underwater materials. During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], several subtugs were stationed at the [[Underwater Zeta Zero Nine base|underwater base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeta Zero Nine]]. They were seen bringing [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] in special protective bubbles to the surface.<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
